title: Quartz Edge - Commerce Onboarding Notes
estimated_traffic: ~50 rps peak for recommend endpoint; 5M tokens/day steady-state estimated
notes: Call 2025-10-11 with Quartz Edge (CTO Tom Muller, ML lead Priya Sharma). High-level ask: replace current SaaS recommendation API with Redwood-hosted/dedicated inference for improved latency and cost predictability ahead of holiday spike. They have a mixed workload: short chat-style product Q&A (95% < 256 tokens) and occasional long session reranks for cart personalization (up to 4k tokens). They emphasized predictable tail latency (<200ms p95) and multi-region routing (US/EU). Key concern: customer PII in prompts + payment token masking; legal requires GDPR-compliant data handling and option for EU-only deployment. They mentioned current infra: Kubernetes cluster with Redis cache, custom batching layer; infra team prefers keeping RBAC and central secrets manager (HashiCorp Vault).
requirements: Latency p95 <= 200ms for text-gen short paths (<=256 tokens)
Support for EU-only private deployment (VPC + KMS/HSM integration)
Dedicated capacity option for holiday burst with defined SLA
Prefix/KV cache integration with existing Redis instance
Model version pinning and canary rollouts for config changes
Audit logs for prompts and responses (masking rules)
gotchas: Legal will not accept raw prompt retention for EU customers without masking rules documented
Current Redis caching semantics differ from Redwood prefix caching -> need compatibility check
Their reranker pipeline uses a custom tokenization step that could affect quantized models
Payment tokens passed in text (masked by frontend, but backend logs may still see placeholders)
open_questions: Do they need full on-prem air-gapped option, or just VPC with customer-managed KMS? (Tom leaning toward VPC+KMS)
Exact SLA target for Dedicated during holiday — will they accept staged canary then full commit?
Which models are acceptable for their accuracy budget vs cost? (Priya prefers local open models vs managed Redwood models)
How many concurrent request streams per merchant session (affects KV cache sizing)?
next_steps: Action: Dana to prepare draft pilot SOW focusing on Dedicated capacity + EU VPC option (due 2025-10-18)
Action: Marco to run quick compatibility test with their tokenization and our quantized 4-bit runtime (target 2025-10-16)
Action: Lea to sketch masking strategy & example audit log format for legal review (send by 2025-10-15)
Schedule: follow-up technical deep-dive with Priya and infra (1hr) — propose 2025-10-20 10:00 PT
Deliverable: rough cost estimate for 50 rps / burst to 200 rps (holiday) + breakouts for hosted vs dedicated vs private
rough_cost_estimate_notes: Back-of-envelope: dedicated pool to hit 50 rps baseline + margin = ~$8k/month; holiday burst reserve to 200 rps for 2 weeks adds ~$6k one-time amortized. Hosted API (pay-as-you-go) likely 20-30% higher unit cost but less ops overhead. Need infra sizing from Marco to refine.
